verdict.rationale: A state tax agency could plausibly publish bulk public-data extracts such as tax statistics, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only probes showing Akamai 403 denials at www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt and webapp.ftb.ca.gov. Nothing documents any dataset, bulk download, or extract offering.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
